splitstone.player_report.title: Report a player
splitstone.player_report.what.hint: Tell us what happened, in your own words.
splitstone.player_report.link.hint: For example a video clip: https://…
splitstone.player_report.link.bad: Use an http or https address
splitstone.player_report.shots.rule: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB each. F2 takes one.
splitstone.player_report.shots.none: No screenshots yet. Press F2 in game to take one.
splitstone.player_report.offline: Not connected to Splitstone. Reports can be sent once you are signed in.
splitstone.player_report.no_answer: No answer from Splitstone. Try again later.
splitstone.player_report.received.title: Thanks, your report arrived.
splitstone.player_report.received.days: A person from the Splitstone team will look at it, usually within %s days. That's a typical time, not a promise.
splitstone.player_report.received.few_da: A person from the Splitstone team will look at it, usually within a few days. That's a typical time, not a promise.
splitstone.player_report.refused.duplica: You already reported this player for this profile, message or match.
splitstone.player_report.refused.too_man: You've sent the most reports allowed for today. Try again tomorrow.
splitstone.player_report.refused.not_fou: That player, message or match could not be found.
splitstone.player_report.refused.bad_scr: A screenshot could not be sent: it is missing, over 2 MB, or not a PNG or JPEG.
splitstone.player_report.refused.bad_lin: The link must be an http or https address.
splitstone.player_report.refused.unavail: Reports can't be taken right now. Try again later.
splitstone.player_report.reviewed.title: We reviewed your report
splitstone.sanction.rule.pretend: Don't pretend to be someone else
splitstone.sanction.decided: A founder decided this, not an automated tool.
splitstone.sanction.warning.body: This is a warning. Breaking a rule again can lead to a chat ban.
splitstone.sanction.chat_ban.until: You can't use chat or voice until %s. You can still play.
splitstone.sanction.chat_ban.indefinite: You can't use chat or voice until a founder lifts this. You can still play.
splitstone.sanction.play_ban.until: You can't play matches until %s. Private rooms stay open.
splitstone.sanction.play_ban.indefinite: You can't play matches until a founder lifts this. Private rooms stay open.
splitstone.sanction.permanent_ban.body: You can't play matches, and this ban never ends. Your items and coins were removed and your Supporter subscription was cancelled. Chat, voice and private rooms are closed to you, and you can't buy or gift anything.
splitstone.sanction.appeal.none: Think this is wrong? Appeal and tell us why. A founder reads every appeal.
splitstone.sanction.appeal.sent: Your appeal was sent. A founder will read it, and you'll be told what they decide.
splitstone.sanction.appeal.upheld: A founder read your appeal and kept this.
splitstone.sanction.appeal.lifted: A founder read your appeal and lifted this.
splitstone.sanction.appeal.label: Why do you think this is wrong?
splitstone.sanction.appeal.hint: Say what happened in your own words.
splitstone.sanction.refused.failed: Your appeal couldn't be sent. Try again later.
splitstone.sanction.code: Or appeal at splitstonemc.com/appeal with the code %s.
